gloss: to go back to square one; to start from scratch; to scrap

definitions.gloss: to go back to square one; to start from scratch; to cancel and redo
definitions.explanation: To abandon plans, agreements, or progress and return to the very beginning, as if nothing had been decided yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: Scrap the plan and start over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}された。
examples.english: The negotiations were sent back to square one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}すこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Facing opposition from residents, the city decided to scrap the development plan.

notes:
Literally "to return to blank paper." ⟦{白紙|はくし}→白紙：13626_hakushi⟧ (blank paper) symbolizes a state where nothing has been written or decided — a clean slate.

USAGE:
Common in news and formal contexts when plans, policies, or agreements are completely canceled. Stronger than simply revising or modifying — it implies everything is discarded and must be reconsidered from zero. Often used in passive form: {白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}された.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す — to scrap a plan
- ⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す — to void an agreement
- {白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}して⟦{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す→考え直す：04591_kangaenaosu⟧ — to go back to the drawing board
- ⟦{白紙|はくし}→白紙：13626_hakushi⟧⟦{撤回|てっかい}→撤回：12910_tekkai⟧ — complete withdrawal/cancellation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}る→振り出しに戻る：18867_furidashinimodoru⟧ — to go back to the starting point
- ⟦{撤回|てっかい}→撤回：12910_tekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to retract, to withdraw; to take back a statement or proposal
- ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ — to redo; more casual, implies trying again
